summary:
Added a "Forgot password?" link on the log in page and a `/reset-password` page (email + new password) that updates the stored account and returns the user to log in. Build passes.

Reading taken: the smaller one — the reset page takes just the two fields the request names (email, new password), with no token/confirm-field flow. Applied the project's existing password rules: the five rules render as a muted hint list under the new-password field and unmet rules turn error-coloured on submit, which blocks the reset. The password rules live in a new shared `src/components/PasswordRules.jsx` so the sign-up page can use the same list. Any real token-based reset mail/verification belongs to the backend repository and was not faked here.
blockers: Not applied -- Emailing a reset link / token verification: belongs to the backend repository; not stubbed here
conventions: Passwords must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number and one special character (any non-alphanumeric)
Wherever a password is chosen (sign up, reset), the five rules are always displayed under the password field and unmet rules are marked in error colour on submit, blocking submission
Password rules and their checks come from src/components/PasswordRules.jsx — do not re-declare them per page
Pages are components in src/pages/ registered by path in the src/App.jsx routes map

visual_check.evidence: The login page shows a 'Forgot password?' link under the Log in button, and /reset-password renders a 'Reset your password' card with Email and New password fields plus the five project password rules displayed under the password field as muted hints.

context_sharing.notes: These files implement and consume no HTTP API — there is no fetch/XHR and no server call anywhere in them. All state lives client-side in localStorage under the key 'acme-users' (a map of lowercased, trimmed email -> User) and sessionStorage under 'acme-current' (the current user's email), via src/store.js (findUser, saveUser, setCurrentUser, currentUser). The only 'paths' are client-side routes in src/App.jsx: '/signup', '/login', '/welcome', '/reset-password', resolved from window.location.pathname with '/signup' as the fallback; any dev/prod server must serve the SPA for all of these. Password rules are defined once in src/components/PasswordRules.jsx and matched by exact label string, so any server-side validation must use the same five labels character for character.
